learning_outcomes.text: Student explains construction and principle of operation of measurement instruments. Student chooses suitable measuring instrument for measure given quantity. Student measures. Student analyses results of measurements. Student calculates measuring errors.
Student recognizes mechanical quantities subject to measurement. Determine measurement methods and systems.

syllabus_topics: Methods, errors and uncertainty of measurements
Tolerance and fit of lengths and angles
Principles of interchangeability of machine parts
Elements of geometrical product specifications, tolerances of form, directions and position
Characteristic of surface geometrical workpiece structure
Measure standards and instruments of measurement
Coordinate measuring machine and measurement systems
assessment_rules: To pass the subject, a minimum of 50.0% is required for Laboratory, Exercises, and Lecture components.
